export function GrowthRings() {
  return (
    <svg
      className="rail__grain"
      viewBox="0 0 560 560"
      preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid slice"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
    >
      {rings.map((d) => (
        <path key={d.slice(0, 16)} d={d} strokeWidth="1" />
      ))}
    </svg>
  );
}
